item.title: BE:FIRST Is Ready for the World: Inside the J-Pop Superstars’ Long-Planned U.S. Breakthrough
item.description:
Here's a short and engaging podcast script based on the article:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our show, where we dive into the latest trends in music. Today, we're talking about the rising J-pop band, BE:FIRST. With a dozen No. 1s on the Billboard Japan Hot 100, they're taking the world by storm. I'm your host, and let's get started.
[Music transitions to a clip of BE:FIRST's song]
Host: BE:FIRST is making waves with their new single, "BRUCE WAYNE", a swaggering, Atlanta hip-hop influenced track featuring Flo Milli. But what's behind this new release? The band has just announced a US distribution partnership with The Orchard, and they're gearing up for a world tour this fall.
[Music transitions back to the host]
Host: We spoke with the band members, who are currently in Los Angeles, taking English lessons, rehearsing choreography, and undergoing media training. They're serious about making it big in the US market. And it's not just talk - they're taking action. They'll be performing at the 2026 World Hip-Hop Dance Championship in Phoenix, and then at Head in the Clouds in Los Angeles.
[Music transitions to a clip of BE:FIRST's upcoming tour dates]
Host: But that's not all. BE:FIRST is set to release their first "global" EP, WATCH ME, on September 18th, featuring tracks with BIA and production from Tommy "TBHits" Brown. And, they're embarking on a world tour, with two shows slated in New York.
[Music transitions back to the host]
Host: The band members are focused and driven, with a clear vision for their global push. As Manato says, "No time to play, basically." With their sights set on the US market, BE:FIRST is ready to take the world by storm. Stay tuned for more updates on this rising J-pop band.
[Outro music plays]
Host: Thanks for tuning in to our show. Don't forget to follow us for the latest music news and trends. Until next time, goodbye!
